Package com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim

Class SimulatedLimelight

java.lang.Object
com.stzteam.features.robotlocalization.vision.sim.SimulatedLimelight
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class SimulatedLimelight extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A simulated Limelight camera: PhotonVision generates the detections and this class publishes them using the NetworkTables schema of a real Limelight.

The idea is that production robot code does not change a single line. If your subsystem reads LimelightHelpers.getTX("limelight-front") against real hardware, it will read the same thing against this simulation.

Usage


 public class Robot extends TimedRobot {
     private final SimulatedLimelight frontCamera =
             new SimulatedLimelight(
                     "limelight-front",
                     new Transform3d(
                             new Translation3d(0.3, 0.0, 0.25),
                             new Rotation3d(0.0, Units.degreesToRadians(-20.0), 0.0)),
                     LimelightSimConfig.limelight3G());

     @Override
     public void simulationPeriodic() {
         frontCamera.periodic(drivetrain.getSimulatedPose());
     }
 }

On a real robot

The constructor detects RobotBase.isReal() and creates nothing: no VisionSystemSim, no SimDevice, no NetworkTables entries. periodic(Pose2d) becomes an immediate return, so you can leave the instance declared at no cost during competition.

Out of scope for now

  • The json key / LimelightHelpers.getLatestResults.
  • Neural detector pipelines (tclass, rawdetections).
  • Modelling a movable crosshair: tx and txnc come out equal.

  • Constructor Details

    • SimulatedLimelight

      public SimulatedLimelight(String name, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d robotToCamera)
      Creates a simulated camera with the default configuration (Limelight 3G profile, the feature's default field).
      Parameters:
      name - the camera's name; used as the NetworkTables table and as the device name in the Sim GUI.
      robotToCamera - transform from the robot origin to the camera, in the WPILib convention (X forward, Y left, Z up).

    • SimulatedLimelight

      public SimulatedLimelight(String name, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Transform3d robotToCamera, LimelightSimConfig config)
      Creates a simulated camera.

      The name wins: it overwrites the configuration's tableName, so the name you see in the Sim GUI and the NT table's name cannot diverge.

      Parameters:
      name - the camera's name.
      robotToCamera - transform from the robot origin to the camera, in the WPILib convention.
      config - configuration of optics, field and keys to publish.

    • close

      public void close()
      Releases the camera and its SimDevice. On a real robot there is nothing to release.

      The shared simulated world survives: other cameras may still be using it. To wipe it entirely use VisionSimWorld.reset().

      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
